name: optcatalog_build_impact_hit_list
description: OptCatalog::BuildImpactHitList temporarily masks the projectile raycast flag, gathers impact hits around the runtime position, restores raycastability, and rejects owner-only hits unless allowed.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b09d0 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRuntimeInstanceStorage*, stack arguments for allow-owner-only and outHitList, temporary gwNodeSetRaycastable(projectile, 0/1) around the filter call, g_Player_RuntimeDiScene as the world, runtimeInstance->pos as the center, self->impactProximity as the radius, enableDistanceCull and requireLineOfSight set to 1, and final return as FilterRegions success with owner-only rejection.
The native smoke verifies successful hit-list construction, projectile raycastable restoration, and rejection of a single owner-only hit when the flag disallows it.
